answer_1.quote: We propose a new task of text style transfer between expert language and layman language, namely Expertise Style Transfer...
answer_1.outputs: transferred sentences (from expert to layman or layman to expert)

answer_2.quote: Following , we make an automatic evaluation on three aspects: Style Accuracy (marked as Acc) aims to measure how accurate the model controls sentence style... Fluency (marked as PPL)... Content Similarity measures... BLEU... and between outputs and gold human references (marked as ref-BLEU)... we also utilize a TS evaluation metrics: SARI.

answer_4.quote: We thus also conduct human evaluation. To evaluate over the entire test set, only layman annotators are involved... Each annotator is asked to rate the model output given both input and gold references. The rating ranges from 1 to 5, where higher values indicate that more semantic content is preserved.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate model outputs on a scale of 1 to 5 based on semantic content preservation, with input and gold references provided.
